title: Roadmap readout + sprint alignment and stakeholder commitment kit
creator: Kaitlin Park
description:
Objective: Produce a compact, repeatable 'commitment kit' for monthly roadmap readouts and QBR-style exec reviews that aligns sprint-level execution with leadership asks. The kit bundles a one-page narrative, initiative health heatmap, explicit decision asks and options, an owners & risks table, and a stakeholder commitment template to capture agreed scope changes during the readout.

Why this exists:
- Leadership needs concise tradeoffs (cost/latency/coverage) when reviewing roadmap shifts.
- Engineers need a deterministic outcome (what to do next sprint) after the readout to avoid misaligned priorities.
- Design & Security need to see surface impacts before commitment.

Deliverables:
1) One-page Readout (TL;DR progress, top 3 risks, top 3 decisions needed)
2) Initiative Health Heatmap (R/Y/G by objective + trendline)
3) Decision Ask Templates (binary + conditional options, expected intent)
4) Sprint Alignment Table (owner, scope, must-have vs nice-to-have)
5) Stakeholder Commitment Sheet + follow-up cadence
6) Example Slack + email templates for post-readout confirmation

Scope / Out of scope:
- In scope: Product + Eng + Design readout artifacts for monthly & QBR cadence, templates, and one-run facilitation guide.
- Out of scope: Full board deck creation (separate ticket), financial modelling for C-suite ask (finance to supply inputs).
